# Hugh Carrow

## Overview

- **Age:** 14 years old in Volume 1; around 19–20 years old by Volume 4  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c25 P61](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0061)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- **Role:** Student, schoolteacher, and medical doctor  <sub>[v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c26 P24](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0024), [v1 c36 P9](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0009)</sub>
- **Titles:** Captain of the Freshman football team  <sub>[v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010)</sub>; Medalist  <sub>[v1 c36 P3](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0003)</sub>; Doctor  <sub>[v1 c36 P9](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0009)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Hughie  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Hugh is a tall youth with chestnut-colored wavy hair, mischievous light-brown or hazel eyes, and a handsome, open face. He possesses a mocking grin, a well-defined, magnificent chin, and broad shoulders as he matures into a tall, manly adult.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c18 P17](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0017), [v1 c19 P0](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0000), [v1 c38 P49](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0049)_

## Personality

Hugh is a bright, ambitious, and competitive student who takes pride in leading his class, yet he is friendly and generous in victory. He possesses a mischievous, teasing nature, often engaging in pranks or playful banter, but is quick to apologize when he realizes he has truly hurt someone's feelings. Possessing a strong sense of duty, idealism, and sportsmanship, he is dedicated to contributing meaningfully to society through medicine and community service, while remaining steadfast and persistent in his personal affections.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c18 P14](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0014), [v1 c28 P31](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0031), [v1 c38 P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055)_

## History

Hugh grows up in Brierley, having spent three childhood years in Alberta with his father. Upon returning from a summer in New Brunswick, he re-enters Brierley school, where he becomes a fierce academic rival to Nell Harcourt after pulling her braid and getting her slate broken over his head. Though he apologizes, Nell holds a grudge against him, even when he defends her to the teacher or tries to offer gifts. Hugh attends Regent's Academy alongside Nell, entering the advanced classes and competing closely with her for top honors. He later serves as the president of the Brierley Village Improvement Society, advocating for local beautification projects. To pay for his medical degree at Wexcombe College, he works as a schoolteacher at Pale Sands. At Wexcombe, he excels academically, becomes Captain of the Freshman football team, wins the Cooper Prize, and earns High Honors in Classics. During his university years, he repeatedly attempts to declare his love to Nell, but she initially turns him down due to her own romantic illusions. After nearly dying of typhoid fever at Seven Gulls, Hugh recovers and resumes his medical career, taking over his great-uncle's practice in Glen St. Agnes. Following his recovery, he and Nell reconcile, acknowledge their mutual love, and become engaged. They marry in the Grey Shutters orchard and move into a small white house by the shore at Seven Gulls.

## Background by volume

- Lived in Alberta for three years with his father during his childhood  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- Spent a summer visiting cousins in New Brunswick before returning to Brierley school  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
